description: Get one Nema by Anahana product by its sku from list_products (e.g. "complete-guide-en"): name, type, language, list price, currency, and url — the product's page on anahana.com, the only place to buy it. Paid products carry checkout_note: "buyers outside the US see a converted price with a 4% conversion fee at checkout". A sku that is in the catalog but not on sale returns available: false, a definitive answer; do not retry it. Read-only: no checkout, no payment link.
